import csv
from io import StringIO

csv_content = """Name,Email,Amount,Description
Jeffrey Smith,jefsmith@gmail.com,$50,After Party
Mason Smith,masmith@gmail.com,$5,Climbing Tape
Tammy Weaver,ta.weav@gmail.com,$12,Notebooks
Ashley Moore,as_moore@gmail.com,$40,Reading Glasses
Jordan Harrison,jo-harr@gmail.com,$80,Climbing Backpack
Travis Wilson,tra_wils@gmail.com,$20,E-Books
Tracy Weber,tra_weber@gmail.com,$10,Bike Bell"""

reader = csv.DictReader(StringIO(csv_content))
debts = []
for row in reader:
    name = row["Name"].strip()
    email = row["Email"].strip()
    amount_raw = row["Amount"].strip()
    amount = float(amount_raw.replace("$", "").replace(",", ""))
    description = row["Description"].strip()
    # Match PDF filename from description (lowercase, spaces replaced with underscores)
    pdf_file = description.lower().replace(" ", "_") + ".pdf"
    debts.append({
        "name": name,
        "email": email,
        "amount": amount,
        "description": description,
        "pdf_file": pdf_file
    })
    print(f"  {name} | {email} | ${amount} | {description} | PDF: {pdf_file}")

# Expected available PDFs from the history:
print("\nAvailable PDFs:")
for pdf in ["after_party.pdf", "bike_bell.pdf", "climbing_backpack.pdf", "climbing_tape.pdf", "e-books.pdf", "notebooks.pdf", "reading_glasses.pdf", "resume.pdf"]:
    matches = [d for d in debts if d["pdf_file"] == pdf]
    print(f"  {pdf}: {'✓ matched' if matches else '✗ unused'}")
